chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“Any believer who extends a kindness to his fellow believer has indeed extended that to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.”

key_terms.أَخِيهِ: his brother; here meaning his fellow believer
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer; the recipient of the kindness
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.مَعْرُوفًا: a good deed, kindness, or beneficent act
key_terms.مُؤْمِنٍ: a believer; one who possesses faith

ai.seo_question: How does showing kindness to another believer relate to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله؟
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that doing good to a fellow believer is of immense spiritual value. Such kindness is regarded as having reached the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, showing the noble rank of serving believers and strengthening bonds within the community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: “Any believer who extends kindness to his fellow believer has indeed extended that kindness to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family)."
